support_claim: Commercial notes record that Oakfield Logistik GmbH is the 2023 rebrand of Oakfield Logistics GmbH with unchanged Handelsregister HRB 88421, the contract MSA-OAK-2018 names Oakfield Logistics GmbH as counterparty, and billing records bill Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
justification: Under the identity contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet provides establishing evidence—not mere name similarity—that the billing referent and the counterparty named in contract MSA-OAK-2018 are one legal entity: the rebrand note ties the two names to the same unchanged registry number, the contract header identifies the counterparty as the prior legal name, and billing invoices use the current legal name.
